description.value: Cedar Beach Ocean Lodge is a small bed and breakfast with two rooms located on Thetis Island, a quiet Gulf Island accessible by BC Ferries from Chemainus. Its name suggests a beachside or ocean-view setting on Clam Bay Road. Thetis Island's car-light, rural character makes it a tranquil stop for cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands.
